description: Propose a design convention for a kind of product: its established form, the stock parts it uses and the checks a design must pass, with up to three public sources. The proposal joins Debbie's review queue as a protocol_proposal event and is never an entry: only Debbie promotes knowledge into the protocol, writing the entry under a new contract version that names her deb8 record. Entry ids, records, versions and status are refused.

established_form.description: How firms already build this kind of product.

kind.description: The kind of product, e.g. "small indoor multirotor".

match.description: Words that identify this kind of product.

items.description: A word that appears in descriptions of this kind of product.
An https link to public material.

part.description: A stock part the form uses.

why.description: Why that form is the established one.

name: propose_design_convention
